gloss: sense of despair; feeling of hopelessness

definitions.gloss: sense of despair; feeling of hopelessness
definitions.explanation: The subjective feeling or emotional experience of despair. Adds the nuance of a felt sensation to the concept of despair (絶望), emphasizing the emotional weight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{絶望感|ぜつぼうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: I was overcome by a deep sense of despair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧だ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{絶望感|ぜつぼうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A feeling of hopelessness spread — a sense that nothing would work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、{絶望感|ぜつぼうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: The opposing team scored a comeback just before the end of the game, and we were enveloped in despair.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}→絶望：04863_zetsubou⟧ (despair) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense). The suffix ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ turns the abstract concept of despair into a word for the subjective emotional experience. This pattern is productive in Japanese: ⟦{孤独感|こどくかん}→孤独感：05995_kodokukan⟧ (sense of loneliness), ⟦{達成感|たっせいかん}→達成感：05952_tasseikan⟧ (sense of achievement), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶望感|ぜつぼうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧ (to be seized by despair)
- {絶望感|ぜつぼうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to be enveloped in despair)
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{絶望感|ぜつぼうかん} (deep sense of despair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絶望|ぜつぼう}→絶望：04863_zetsubou⟧: despair — the state or concept itself, without the emphasis on felt sensation
- {失望感|しつぼうかん}: sense of disappointment — less intense than {絶望感|ぜつぼうかん}
